metadata.title: Zephyr Protocol Security Audit Checklist - Batch 5
metadata.description: Partial checklist covering properties PROP-084 through PROP-110 (excluding boundary edges already covered in Stage 1)

checklist.title: Fee Calculation Ceiling Rounding Verification

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE triggers fee calculation using ceiling rounding to protect the protocol from undercollection.
steps: Locate IncentiveLib.computeFee() implementation
Verify ceiling rounding formula: (a + b - 1) / b or equivalent
Check that fee calculation is mandatory in unwrap flow
Verify no bypass path exists to skip fee calculation
Test edge cases with small amounts where rounding matters

executable_checks.description: Test fee calculation with various amounts
executable_checks.focus: Verify ceiling rounding vs floor rounding

checklist.notes: Ceiling rounding protects protocol from undercollection - floor rounding would favor users

checklist.title: Burn Before Transfer Ordering Enforcement

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 triggers burn operation AFTER fee calculation but BEFORE underlying transfer to prevent double-spend risk.
steps: Trace unwrap() execution flow in LiquidityManager
Verify burn is called after fee calculation
Verify burn completes before transfer operation
Check for reentrancy that could reorder operations
Verify burn amount matches user request minus fee

checklist.notes: Critical ordering - burn before transfer prevents double-spend

checklist.title: Underlying Transfer Amount Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING transfers exactly (amount - fee) after burn, with no user input affecting final amount.
steps: Locate transfer call in unwrap flow
Verify transfer amount = burned amount - fee
Check no external input can manipulate transfer amount
Verify deterministic calculation path
Test with various amounts and fee configurations

executable_checks.focus: Verify transfer amounts across various inputs

checklist.notes: Final step sends underlying to user - amount must be exact

checklist.title: Unwrap Completion Event Emission

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE emits Unwrapped event atomically after successful underlying transfer with correct parameters.
steps: Locate Unwrapped event definition
Verify event is emitted after successful transfer
Check event parameters match actual transferred amounts
Verify atomic emission with function completion
Test event capture in transaction logs

executable_checks.focus: Event emission timing and data accuracy

checklist.notes: Verifiable via transaction logs - terminal success state

checklist.title: Insufficient Liquidity Detection

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY correctly routes to failure when liquidity is insufficient, comparing against (underlyingBalance - feeSurplus).
steps: Locate liquidity check in unwrap flow
Verify comparison: requested <= (balance - feeSurplus)
Check revert message is informative
Verify check occurs before burn (no partial state)
Test boundary conditions for liquidity check

executable_checks.focus: Verify clean revert before any state change

checklist.notes: Solvency check prevents failed transfers - check before burn

checklist.title: BN254 Field Constraint Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE triggers BN254 field constraint check via _afterTokenTransfer hook on every transfer.
steps: Locate _afterTokenTransfer hook in zERC20
Verify hook is called for every transfer (OpenZeppelin guarantee)
Check BN254 scalar field constraint: value < 2^248
Verify no bypass path around the hook
Test with values at and above the limit

checklist.notes: Hook mechanism enforces validation - ZK circuit compatibility requirement

checklist.title: Oversized Value Transfer Revert

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE correctly reverts transfers exceeding 2^248-1 to maintain ZK circuit compatibility.
steps: Locate value comparison against MAX_VALUE constant
Verify MAX_VALUE = 2^248 - 1
Check deterministic revert for oversized values
Verify error message is clear
Test boundary values (2^248-1, 2^248, 2^256-1)

executable_checks.focus: Test with values at and above limit

checklist.notes: Protection for ZK circuit compatibility - deterministic rejection

checklist.title: Balance Update Path Dependency

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES is only traversed for valid values, with failed validation causing revert before balance update.
steps: Trace transfer execution flow
Verify validation occurs before balance update
Check failed validation reverts the entire transaction
Verify no partial balance update possible
Confirm sequential dependency: validate -> update

checklist.notes: Sequential dependency enforces ordering - OpenZeppelin flow guarantees

checklist.title: Hash Chain Extension Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN appends (to, value) to hash chain after balance update using SHA-256.
steps: Locate hash chain update in _afterTokenTransfer
Verify hash computation: sha256(prev_hash || to || value)
Check update is mandatory in transfer flow
Verify actual transfer parameters are used (not user input)
Test hash chain integrity across multiple transfers

executable_checks.description: Verify hash chain after multiple transfers

checklist.notes: SHA-256 collision resistance - deterministic hash chain extension

checklist.title: IndexedTransfer Event Monotonicity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT emits IndexedTransfer with monotonically increasing index, preventing duplicate indices.
steps: Locate IndexedTransfer event and emission
Verify index counter is storage variable
Check atomic increment: counter++
Verify single-threaded execution prevents races
Test index continuity across multiple transfers

executable_checks.focus: Verify monotonic increase with no gaps

checklist.notes: Event ordering is deterministic - indexer depends on monotonic indices

checklist.title: Transfer Atomicity Verification

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE finalizes transfer only after all steps complete atomically within the transaction.
steps: Trace full transfer execution path
Verify transaction atomicity: all steps or none
Check STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE is truly final
Verify no partial state possible on revert
Confirm Solidity transaction guarantees apply

checklist.notes: Atomic transaction completion - Solidity guarantee

checklist.title: Indexer Event Subscription Configuration

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-INDEXER-WATCHES initiates event subscription from the correct trusted contract address.
steps: Review indexer service configuration
Verify watched contract address matches deployed zERC20
Check event filter configuration for IndexedTransfer
Verify websocket/RPC connection reliability
Review fallback mechanisms for missed events

checklist.notes: Semi-trusted service - misconfiguration produces invalid proofs caught on-chain

checklist.title: Merkle Tree Construction Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-INDEXER-TREE-UPDATED correctly extends the Merkle tree with new leaves, producing valid roots.
steps: Review Merkle tree implementation in indexer
Verify leaf insertion algorithm correctness
Check tree recomputation after insertion
Verify deterministic root computation
Test root computation against reference implementation

checklist.notes: Incorrect construction produces proofs that fail on-chain verification

checklist.title: Merkle Proof Generation Soundness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-INDEXER-GENERATES-PROOF produces valid Merkle inclusion proofs for requested leaves.
steps: Review proof generation algorithm
Verify sibling path extraction is correct
Check proof includes all necessary siblings
Verify proof format matches verifier expectations
Test generated proofs against local verification

checklist.notes: Proof correctness is verifiable on-chain - deterministic from correct tree

checklist.title: Hash Chain Checkpoint Authenticity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-CHECKPOINT-RESERVED stores the authentic hash chain state from zERC20 with HashChainReserved event.
steps: Locate reserve hash chain function in Verifier
Verify hash chain is read from trusted zERC20 contract
Check no transformation or user input affects stored value
Verify HashChainReserved event is emitted
Confirm checkpoint binding is immutable once stored

executable_checks.focus: Verify stored value matches zERC20 state

checklist.notes: Authentic checkpoint binding - foundation for proof verification

checklist.title: Checkpoint Prerequisite for Proof Submission

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-AWAITING-NOVA-PROOF only allows proof acceptance after valid checkpoint exists.
steps: Locate proof submission function
Verify checkpoint existence check before proof processing
Check sequential dependency: checkpoint -> proof submission
Verify no path allows proof without prior checkpoint
Test proof submission without checkpoint

checklist.notes: Checkpoint is prerequisite for proof - sequential dependency

checklist.title: Nova Proof Cryptographic Verification

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-VALID is only traversed after successful Groth16 cryptographic verification of the Nova proof.
steps: Locate Groth16 verification call for transfer root proof
Verify verifier contract address is correct
Check all public inputs are properly bound
Verify verification failure causes revert (not silent failure)
Test with invalid proofs

executable_checks.focus: Proof verification call and error handling

executable_checks.description: Attempt to submit invalid Nova proofs

checklist.notes: Groth16 soundness - success path from proof verification

checklist.title: Divergent Proof Emergency Detection

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-DIVERGENT-PROOF-DETECTED triggers emergency when conflicting roots are proved for the same index.
steps: Locate divergent proof detection logic
Verify comparison: new_root != existing_root for same index
Check emergency trigger is immediate on detection
Verify no silent acceptance of divergent proofs
Test with conflicting valid proofs

executable_checks.focus: Divergent proof detection and emergency trigger

executable_checks.description: Test with conflicting roots for same index

checklist.notes: Defense mechanism for protocol integrity - prevents inconsistent state

checklist.title: LayerZero Message Submission Confirmation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-ROOT-RELAYED confirms LayerZero message submission via _lzSend call success.
steps: Locate _lzSend call for root relay
Verify call either succeeds or reverts (no silent failure)
Check STATE-ROOT-RELAYED only reached on success
Verify message payload includes correct root data
Test with LayerZero fee edge cases

executable_checks.focus: Verify message delivery and state transition

checklist.notes: LayerZero API call - success or revert, no partial state

checklist.title: Hub EID Validation Before Root Storage

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-HUB-UPDATES-ROOT stores validated root only after EID verification in _lzReceive.
steps: Locate _lzReceive handler in Hub contract
Verify EID validation is first step
Check root storage only occurs after validation
Verify no bypass of EID check
Test with messages from invalid EIDs

checklist.notes: Sequential validation before storage - cross-chain security
